info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Corporate Lease Management API
info.description: The Corporate Lease Management API facilitates businesses in managing their leasing agreements for corporate assets. This endpoint allows users to create new corporate lease agreements, ensuring a streamlined process for asset acquisition and utilization. Typical consumers include finance departments and asset managers looking to optimize their leasing operations. The API supports essential operations related to corporate leases, enhancing the efficiency of financial transactions within an organization.

post.description: This endpoint allows you to create a new corporate lease in the deposit lending system. Provide the necessary details in the request body to successfully create a lease associated with a corporate client.

requestBody.description: The request body contains the necessary information for initiating a corporate lease in the deposit lending context. Ensure that all required fields are provided accurately for successful processing.
